question: Should the merged Windows ownership hardening be published as v0.4.6 from the current main commit now?
rationale: The patch is mechanically appropriate, but only repository release ownership can authorize the exact version and protected tag timing for a security-relevant package publication.

options.title: Cut v0.4.6 now
options.body: Merge the metadata update and create the protected v0.4.6 tag from the reviewed main state so consumers can install the Windows secure-read hardening.

options.title: Defer the release
options.body: Keep the unreleased section and postpone publication until the release owner selects a different release window or bundles further compatible changes.

recommendation.title: Cut v0.4.6 now
recommendation.body: Merge the metadata update and create the protected v0.4.6 tag from the reviewed main state so consumers can install the Windows secure-read hardening.
